trusted_assumptions: vstd specifications for str::is_char_boundary and str::len.
The str::as_ptr representation contract exposes the string bytes and bounds their length by usize::MAX.
Raw-pointer add and core::slice::from_raw_parts preserve the modeled byte region.
rationale: The branch is copied exactly and the private split_at_unchecked call is mechanically inlined from Rust 1.96. The proof uses lower raw-memory representation contracts without assuming the target contract.
